llm_response.reason: The website mimics Lazada, a major e-commerce brand, but uses a suspicious and unrelated domain structure. It combines e-commerce and online gambling content, lists an excessive range of products with massive discounts, uses improper business contact methods (live chat only), and links to Lazada’s official apps and social media in an attempt to appear legitimate. These are clear signs of a fake online shopping scam, as outlined in several scam characteristics including mimicking real brands, offering unusually low prices, ambiguous company identity, and improper payment/contact practices.
